title: Open runtime: `requires: ['record-context']` mounts the record-context service, so `get_record_context` exists without hand wiring
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #36996, M2. An independent Fable review of rows 5–10 (2026-11-25) found that no card assembles the service. Maintainer 2026-11-25: 「同意你的建议」.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic child; without it an app that declares packs gets no tool) · reach: every open deployment that ships `aiContexts` · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：应用在配置里声明 `requires: ['record-context']`，开源运行时就自动挂上情境包服务，外部 AI 经 MCP 就能用 `get_record_context`。不声明的部署，什么都不变。
- 为什么：PR #37173 里，这个工具只有在宿主手工挂上 `RecordContextServicePlugin` 时才会出现。BrightRule 这种纯元数据应用（制品启动）没有办法挂插件，写了情境包也没人读。
- 为什么用令牌、不按「有情境包就自动挂」：和知识检索的 `requires: ['knowledge']`（#37102）保持同一种写法；而且是否对外开放一个读工具，应该由应用显式声明，不该随元数据出现而悄悄打开。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. A capability token `record-context`:
   - in `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` (`PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` / `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`);
   - and in `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts#CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`, mapped to `@objectstack/service-record-context`'s `RecordContextServicePlugin`.
2. Readers in the same PR (ADR-0049): `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` and `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`.
3. A host that already mounts the plugin by hand keeps its own (the `Serve.providesCapability` rule); the runtime adds no second one.
4. Without the token, nothing changes: no tool, no service.
5. Docs: where `get_record_context` and `aiContexts` are documented, add one line on the token.

## Acceptance
- A stack with `requires: ['record-context']` and one pack: over MCP, `tools/list` carries `get_record_context`, and a call returns the pack.
- A stack without the token: no tool.
- A host that mounts the plugin by hand gets no second mount.
- An artifact boot (`os serve` on a compiled app) with the token serves the tool.
- Container run per AGENTS.md.

## Out of scope
- The hosted kernel and EE. Cloud folds that into its row-9 card, objectstack-ai/cloud#4978.
- Auto-mounting on the presence of `aiContexts`: not taken, see 维护者速读.
- The knowledge token (#37102).

Blocked-by: #37140 (the package and plugin land there; PR #37173).
Parent: #36996. Reader: the runtime and capability lane (`packages/core`, `packages/spec/src/kernel`, `packages/cli`).
Dedupe: `RecordContextServicePlugin` 0 · `record-context service mount` 95 (none on mounting this service; #37103 is knowledge) · `requires record-context` 221 (no capability card for it).
